docs.summary: Imports .prefab files serialized GameObject hierarchies wrapped in PrefabAsset. Dependencies are read straight from the stored tree, without deserializing the hierarchy.
Version number for cache invalidation. Bump when import logic changes.

Reads a .prefab file, parses its EchoObject tree, flattens any nested prefab links, collects asset dependencies, and sets a PrefabAsset as the main asset. Returns true on success, false on failure with a logged error.
